messages:
Maya: heads-up ran a long trace on the new prefetcher for PP pipeline, seeing a weird waveform in bubble occupancy, attaching perf snippet
Jon: link?
Maya: https://perf.redwood/trace/2149-waveform
Maya: config: TP=2 PP=4 microbatches=16 seq=2048 kernel=kernel_v2
Sam: quick glance — all-reduce spikes line up with kvcache activity?
Maya: yep spikes at step 8 and 12, kvcache flush shows at same offsets
Nora: were you running the kernel-selection heuristic or a forced kernel?
Maya: heuristic enabled; host-3 fell back to int8 kernels on some layers
Liam: fallback could change compute timing and break comm/compute overlap
Jon: can you paste perf counters (compute_ms, nccl_allreduce_ms, comm_wait_ms) around the spike
Maya: counters snapshot:
```
step 7: compute_ms=18.7, nccl_allreduce_ms=3.6, comm_wait_ms=2.8
step 8: compute_ms=18.3, nccl_allreduce_ms=9.7, comm_wait_ms=12.1
step 9: compute_ms=19.1, nccl_allreduce_ms=3.2, comm_wait_ms=2.4
step12: compute_ms=17.9, nccl_allreduce_ms=11.3, comm_wait_ms=13.8
```
Sam: those comm_wait spikes explain the bubble growth — overlap is lost when allreduce jumps
Nora: why is allreduce heavier only on those steps? topology or nvlink hiccup?
Maya: host 3 reports higher PCIe memcopy latencies and shows kernel fallback logs
Liam: kernel fallback -> extra host memcpy + different kernel scheduling -> timing shift
Jon: test idea: force homogeneous kernel (fp16) across all hosts and rerun 8-step microbatch sweep
Maya: starting forced-fp16 run, ETA ~12m
infra-bot: job 59821 queued on infra-cluster-prod-3
Maya: results: waveform smoothed, nccl_allreduce_ms ~4.1 steady, comm_wait_ms <3 across steps
Sam: confirms kernel mismatch was primary trigger; secondary was kvcache eviction alignment
Nora: mitigation thinking: add small microbatch jitter per replica so eviction windows don't sync
Liam: plus aggressive prefetch for KV pages a few microbatches earlier when eviction predicted
Jon: both sound reasonable — prefer prefetch first (low risk), then jitterer as opt-in scheduler flag
Maya: will open PR for runtime with flags: pp_prefetch_lookahead and microbatch_offset_jitter
Maya: rough perf delta from this run: tail latency p95 down ~18%, throughput up ~4% for the traced workload
Sam: nice. we should add regression in perf harness covering TP=2 PP=4 seq=2k to prevent regressions
Nora: also add a trace-trigger for kvcache_flush events to auto-capture future runs
Maya: PR: https://git.redwood/r/pp-runtime/merge_requests/732 — proto and perf log included
Liam: assigning to eng-runtime leads for review
Jon: follow-up: run cross-host stress with forced-algo selection (ring vs tree) for allreduce
Maya: noted — will schedule after review
Jon: thanks all :tada:
Maya: adding checklist in the PR for QA steps: reproduce, force-fp16 baseline, prefetch toggle, jitter toggle
Sam: can we also surface kvcache eviction timestamps in Console traces? would help debugging
Nora: yes; add kvcache events to trace schema (lightweight)
infra-bot: perf-harness job 59822 finished: artifacts uploaded to https://perf.redwood/artifacts/59822
Maya: marking this thread resolved for immediate triage, will follow up in PR comments
Jon: closing loop — great catch and mitigation path
